title: Sharp half-depth certificate for the signed-rank-one family
statement: For every n and 0<mu<=1, A=mu I+(1-mu)ss^T satisfies H_{ceil(n/2)}(A)>=(mu/2)A^{-1}. Together with the iterated n-to-infinity then mu-to-one limit, the constant 1/2 is sharp on this family.
assumptions: Uniform random permutation and determinant-tail Bellman depth ceil(n/2)
For sharpness, n tends to infinity before mu tends upward to one
open_objections: The proof uses the two-block permutation symmetry of a signed-rank-one lift and does not extend to a general correlation matrix.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
